observed_facts: The saved max_num_batched_tokens=2048 trial completed with 96/96 successful requests and zero generation errors (measured_facts.trials[1].reduced).
Its p95 latency was 773.763 ms versus the 774.183 ms baseline, only a 0.054% improvement, below the required 5% (metrics.trial_2_p95_latency_ms; inspection_records[1].diagnosis.observed.objective).
Trial quality was verified at 1.0 and passed the 0.99 floor (measured_facts.trials[1].quality).
No trials remain and no supported changes are available (remaining_trials; supported_changes).
hypothesis: The earlier hypothesis that reducing max_num_batched_tokens would produce at least a 5% latency improvement is not supported; under this workload it had negligible effect.
predicted_metric_change: Keeping baseline should retain approximately 774 ms p95 latency and verified quality of 1.0; no further improvement is expected from the tested lever.
falsification_condition: Not applicable because the budget is exhausted; any future legal trial would falsify this conclusion only if it achieves at least 5% lower p95 latency while maintaining quality at or above 0.99.
limitations: The conclusion covers only the tested 2048 value. p99 latency is marked unreliable, and no additional candidate can be tested under the supplied budget.
